ttm.note: Latest filed periodic report on or before 2026-10-21 is the Q2 2026 10-Q (Q3 10-Q not yet filed). Finance lease liabilities at Jun 30 2026 are NOT disclosed in the 10-Q (Dec 31 2025: $222m; H1 2026 principal payments $82m), so debt excludes them and is not strictly comparable with the annual base that includes them; excluded rather than estimated. NCI = redeemable 180 (Trendyol GO put/call from Q1 2031) + non-redeemable 903. Long-term investments exclude Delivery Hero total return swaps ($1,504m, in other non-current assets) - they are a DH-equity exposure financed with cash and could arguably be added. Post-period events not in this balance sheet: Getir delivery businesses acquired Jul 1 2026 (~$465m cash), Careem control Jul 30 2026, Delivery Hero takeover offer (EUR 41.50/share, EUR 14.2bn bridge) agreed Jul 16 2026, further debt financing in Aug-Sep 2026 (8-Ks). Redemption value of redeemable NCI is the carrying amount. Other contingently issuable shares of 2.321m (diluted-EPS weighted) are not described in the filing.

notes: Share counts and RSU/option counts are filed in thousands and converted to millions.
Insurance-related restricted cash and restricted investments are excluded from cash and investments (they collateralize insurance reserves).
Both convertible/exchangeable notes are included in debt at carrying value; the exchangeable note is exchangeable into Aurora shares, not Uber shares.
